lines.rom: dhata purastadyamudajahara sakrah pravidva npradisascatasrah tamevam vimdvanamrta iha bhavati nanyah pantha ayanaya vidyate
om sahasrasirsa ndevam visvaksam vimsvasambhuvam visva nnarayana ndevamaksara mparama mpadam
visvatah paramannityam vimsva nnarayanag harim visvameveda mpurusa stadvisva mupajivati
patim vimsvasyatmesvarag sasvatag siva macyutam narayana mmahajneyam vimsvatmana mparayanam
narayanaparo jyotiratma narayanah parah narayanapara mbrahma tattva nnarayanah parah
narayanaparo dhyata dhyana nnarayanah parah yacca kincijjagatsarva ndrsyate sruyate pi va
antarbahisca tatsarvam vyampya narayana ssthitah anantamavyaya nkavig samudre ntam vimsvasambhuvam
padmakosa pratikasag hrdaya ncapyadhomukham adho nistya vitastyante nabhyamupari tisthati
jvalamalakula mbhati visvasyayatana mmahat santatag sirabhistu lambatyakosasannibham
tasyante susirag suksma ntasmin sarva mpratisthitam tasya madhye mahanagni rvisvarci rvisvatomukhah
so grabhugvibhajantistha nnaharamajarah kavih tiryagurdhvamadhassayi rasmayastasya santatah
santapayati sva ndehamapadatalamastakah tasya madhye vahnisikha aniyordhva vyavasthitah
nilato yadamadhyastha dvidyullekheva bhasvara nivarasukavattanvi pita bhasvatyanupama
tasya ssikhaya madhye paramatma vyavasthitah sa brahma sa siva ssa hari ssendra sso ksarah parama ssvarat
rtag satya mpara mbrahma purusa nkrsnapingalam urdhvaretam vimrupaksam vimsvarupaya vai namo namah
o nnarayanaya vidmahe vasudevaya dhimahi tanno visnuh pracodayat
